items.name: qr-code
items.title: QR Code
items.description: Styled, accessible QR code with PNG and SVG download buttons, rendered with the qrdx library.
items.author: bucharitesh <https://qrdx.dev>
items.docs: Import it with `import { QrCode } from "@/components/qr-code"`. Props and examples: https://qrdx.dev/docs/developers/shadcn

items.name: qr-code-scanner
items.title: QR Code Scanner
items.description: Drop-zone that decodes a QR code from an uploaded image in the browser, using the qrdx library.
items.author: bucharitesh <https://qrdx.dev>
items.docs: Import it with `import { QrCodeScanner } from "@/components/qr-code-scanner"`. Props and examples: https://qrdx.dev/docs/developers/shadcn
